prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Polonium (Po) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a museum hands-on workshop table before opening, glass display cases, stools and tall windows
Weather / season: spring — blossom petals drifting outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Outfit: a cut-out mini dress — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small sealed capsule glowing faint blue and warm with its own heat in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — polonium: a rare silvery metal found in July 1898 by a husband-and-wife pair of chemists in pitchblende and named for Poland, the wife's homeland then erased from the map, so the world would not forget it; so fiercely radioactive that a small piece heats itself to hundreds of degrees and makes the air around it glow blue; polonium-210 lasts only 138 days before decaying into quiet lead; it once kept a rover warm through the long lunar night — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536 verified; one main adult woman; painterly anime finish.
Cutout lilac dress, both hands hold capsule with connected wrists.
She stands upright rather than bending toward the museum workbench.
qa.cause: Documented composition/costume/text deviation from the submitted prompt; original generated image retained without regeneration.
